newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles, J&J still in talks.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles, J&J still in talks.

text.p: Britain's Biocompatibles International Plc said on Wednesday it was still in talks with U.S. pharmaceutical giant Johnson and Johnson on licensing its coatings for use on J&J's metallic stents.
The company said it was not expected to conclude negotiations before another "several" weeks.
The share price of Biocompatibles fell in early July on reports that J&J had allowed an option to adopt Biocomptibles' coatings to expire.
On Wednesday it gained 26 1/2 pence to 10.32 1/2 stg on confirmation that talk were still on.
The talks will cover licensing of Biocompatibles non-thrombogenic and drug-delivery phosphorylcholine coatings for use on J&J's metallic stents.
